description: Change the status of content entries — this is how an entry is published, unpublished or archived. Address records the way their meta is laid out: COLLECTION — "entry_ids"; DOCUMENT — "slugs"; SINGLETON and DICTIONARY — neither (one record per locale). i18n models change every supported locale unless "locale" is given. Setting status "published" validates the targeted entries first; if they have errors, nothing is committed. Records already at the requested status are reported as unchanged and not rewritten. contentrain_content_list shows each entry's current status under "meta". Changes are committed to git and follow the project's review or auto-merge workflow — do NOT manually edit .contentrain/meta files.

locale.description: Scope the change to one locale (i18n models only; defaults to every supported locale)

slugs.description: Document slugs (document models only) — a document is addressed by slug, the same identity contentrain_content_save uses

name: contentrain_content_status
